source_note: 由一个级数收敛证明另一个有关级数的收敛问题
english_source_note: Deducing One Series Convergence from Another
callout_id: 由一个级数收敛证明另一个有关级数的收敛问题#3
statement_en: For $x_n\in (0,1)$, assume $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} n x_n<\infty$. Prove that $$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} x_n\log(1/x_n)<\infty.$$
key_techniques: split the index set by size of $x_n$
comparison between logarithmic and polynomial growth
